identifier: FAQ: General: What is the difference between a BigCommerce Payments account and a PayPal Business account?
statement: What is the difference between a BigCommerce Payments account and a PayPal Business account? When you connect BigCommerce Payments, a brand new PayPal platform account dedicated to your BigCommerce store is created. The BigCommerce Payments account is automatically linked to your PayPal Business account. These are two distinct accounts: Your existing PayPal Business account remains fully intact and operational. Nothing about it changes. Your new BigCommerce Payments account is what processes and settles all transactions made through your BigCommerce store going forward.

The Actions section allows you to see real-time alerts for your BigCommerce Payments account. Tasks, such as completing your profile, linking a bank account, Know Your Customer (KYC) status, and fund holds will be displayed here.

The Balance dashboard, located by navigating to Finance › BigCommerce Payments, provides a real-time overview of your BigCommerce Payments account balance. From here, you can also link bank accounts, manage currencies, perform currency conversions, add additional funds to your balance, and manage payouts to linked accounts

You can enable automatic payouts from your BigCommerce Payments balance to a linked bank account or PayPal account. To begin, click Set up auto payments in the upper-right of the dashboard or at the top of the Payouts section. In the pop-up window, select a payout frequency. By default, automatic payouts are transferred to your PayPal account. To switch to a bank account, click Change and link a new account or select an existing one. Note that your entire balance transfers when using automatic payouts. To transfer specific values, perform a manual payout.

You can perform manual payouts from your BigCommerce Payments balance to a linked bank account. To begin, click Payout Now in the upper-right of the dashboard or at the top of the Payouts section. In the pop-up window, click the pencil icon to enter the payout amount. Select Fast to receive the payout in minutes (fees apply) or Standard to receive the payout in up to three business days. If your bank does not offer Fast Payout, you’ll need to link a new one or select Standard. To change the destination bank account, click Change and link a new account or select an existing one. Note that only bank accounts are eligible for manual payout; to transfer your balance to a PayPal account, set up automatic payouts.

identifier: FAQ: Refunds: How soon after a transaction can I perform a refund?
statement: How soon after a transaction can I perform a refund? Once a payment is captured, there is no delay before you can issue a refund. Note that refunds are issued from your BigCommerce Payments balance, not from linked bank accounts. Before performing a refund, check the Balance dashboard to ensure that you have sufficient funds.

identifier: FAQ: Where do I manage my funds?
statement: Where do I manage my funds? You will control and direct funds in your merchant account with your merchant service provider. Usually, this is where you will connect to your bank account or perform refunds external to BigCommerce.

identifier: FAQ: What is a hosted payment gateway?
statement: What is a hosted payment gateway? Hosted payment gateways navigate shoppers away from your checkout to the payment service provider’s page. After entering their payment details and completing the transaction, they are redirected back to your storefront. Hosted payment gateways: Afterpay Amazon Pay BitPay Klarna Mercado Pago Opayo Optty Serve First Sezzle

identifier: FAQ: Transactions: How long until the funds are transferred to my bank?
statement: How long until the funds are transferred to my bank? Funds are deposited immediately into your PayPal account. You can request a withdrawal to your bank at any time, using an Instant Transfer or Standard Transfer (1-3 business days).
scope: the standalone PayPal payment gateway

identifier: Common Questions: Transactions: How long until a transaction's funds are transferred to my bank?

identifier: Common Questions: Additional features: Can I connect multiple Stripe accounts to the same BigCommerce store?

statement: Offline payment methods are ways to pay for orders that do not require a credit card or a traditional payment gateway. These can be helpful alternatives to make payments attainable for shoppers. Unlike most online payment methods, such as through a payment gateway, collecting payment is not immediate in these methods.

identifier: Offline Payment Methods: How It Works: Awaiting Payment
statement: Orders placed using an offline payment method are placed in Awaiting Payment order status. After receiving the payment, you can manually set the order to the Awaiting Fulfillment or another order status as you process the order.

identifier: Configuring Offline Payment Methods: Bank deposit
statement: You can set up your store to allow your customers to make a payment directly into your bank account by setting up a Bank Deposit payment method. This payment method displays your bank account information and instructions to your customer after their order is complete.

identifier: Configuring Offline Payment Methods: Cash on delivery
statement: You can set up your online store to allow your customers to pay you with cash by setting up a Cash on Delivery payment method.

You can set up your online store to allow your customers to pay you by check by setting up a Check payment method. This payment method displays your mailing address and instructions for sending the check when your customer completes their order.

identifier: Configuring Offline Payment Methods: Money order
statement: You can set up your online store to allow your customers to pay you via money order by setting up a Money Order payment method. When a customer completes their order, they will be shown the information and mailing instructions you provide.

identifier: Configuring Offline Payment Methods: Pay in store
statement: The final offline method is Pay in Store, which has your customers make payments at your physical store location.

identifier: Configuring Offline Payment Methods: Available Countries
statement: Available Countries — Check the box for the countries where this payment method is available at checkout.
scope: the countries the merchant checks for each offline payment method

identifier: Performing a Refund: Having trouble issuing a refund?
statement: Having trouble issuing a refund? Make sure that the payment in question has been settled. Some payment gateways settle transactions at a particular time every day or dictate that a transaction must be older than 24 hours before it can be refunded.

identifier: Manually Capturing Transactions (Authorize Only): How It Works
statement: When you enable Authorize only payments for your payment gateway, purchases are not charged to the shopper’s card until you manually capture the funds yourself. When an order is placed, the gateway verifies that the card is valid and has a sufficient balance, then holds the funds until they are captured. After performing the capture, the funds will transfer to your account and you can begin fulfilling the order.

identifier: About BigCommerce Pricing: Open Payment Provider fees: Note
statement: Note: The Open Provider Fee is charged to you by BigCommerce and must not be passed through to shoppers at checkout.
scope: self-serve plans; orders not processed through providers on the Embedded Payment Providers list

identifier: About BigCommerce Pricing: Open Payment Provider fees: invoice
statement: Fees are billed monthly in arrears (after the service period) as a separate line item on your invoice.
scope: self-serve plans; orders not processed through providers on the Embedded Payment Providers list

identifier: Connecting with PayPal: FAQ: Pricing and fees: What fees are associated with PayPal?
statement: What fees are associated with PayPal? PayPal has no monthly fees, but charges a per-transaction fee based on your region. Additionally, the Real-time Account Updater is a paid feature in your PayPal business account. To learn more, go to PayPal Merchant Fees and locate the rates in your region.
scope: the standalone PayPal payment gateway

identifier: bigcommerce.com/product/: FAQ: Does BigCommerce charge payment fees?
statement: Does BigCommerce charge payment fees? BigCommerce does not charge payment fees on orders processed through eligible Embedded Payment Providers. Standard payment processing fees from your chosen payment provider still apply.
scope: orders processed through eligible Embedded Payment Providers

identifier: Manually Capturing Transactions (Authorize Only): FAQ: How can using Authorize only reduce processing fees?
statement: How can using Authorize only reduce processing fees? Some credit card processors charge a fee for chargebacks or refunds. A card that has not been charged does not need to be refunded. By using Authorize only, you do not have to issue refunds for orders that could not be shipped.
